item.title: Publications
item.description: My research focuses on finding semantic relationships in heterogeneous data, including table discovery in data lakes, knowledge graph embedding and link prediction, and metadata alignment, and on using them for information retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG and GraphRAG). Selected publications A. Boutaleb, B. Amann, H. Naacke and R. Angarita. “Something’s Fishy in the Data Lake: A Critical Re-evaluation of Table Union Search Benchmarks.” Table Representation Learning Workshop @ ACL 2025, Vienna, Austria, 2025.

item.title: Research Projects
item.description: Argumentative Graph-RAG for Participatory Democracy, LIP6 AI & Data Science programme, with Nicolas Maudet (Multi-Agent Systems team). 2025 – in progress. Intelligent services for data catalogs, CIFRE industrial PhD partnership with Zeenea (data catalog vendor). 2023 – in progress. Table Discovery in Data Lakes, LIP6 internal project. 2023–2024. Led to HEARTS, a hypergraph-based related table search method. Chair between the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and Isep, head of the chair, at Isep.

item.title: Teaching
item.description: At Paris Nanterre University, since 2022 Complete database curriculum from undergraduate to Master’s level: relational databases, business intelligence, Big Data, NoSQL and data lakes. New Master’s course: Data and Knowledge Engineering for Large Language Models (RAG and KG-RAG architectures, hybrid SQL/embedding search, knowledge graph modelling, data quality and provenance), opening 2026. Year coordinator, L3 MIAGE and dual-degree programmes, since 2023. Vice-President, Consultative Disciplinary Committee, since 2025. Guest lecturer at Télécom Paris and 3iL.
